verdict.rationale: Codex cloud runs delegated tasks in isolated environments. Each repository's dependencies and setup steps can be configured, and results come back as a summary and diff for follow-up or a pull request, which covers the build-and-review part of the story. Testing is only implied by configurable environments and command execution, and nothing shows the agent producing a demo (preview, screenshots, recording) for review. Missing for 10: explicit cloud test-execution evidence, any demo or preview artifact capability, independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end cloud feature delivery.
